queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    count(*)                 as seasons,
    sum(starts)              as starts,
    sum(wins)                as wins,
    sum(podiums)             as podiums,
    sum(poles)               as poles,
    sum(championship_points) as points
from (select * from f1.drivers where driver_id = '${params.driver}' order by year desc)

queries.compiledQueryString:
select cast(year as integer)::varchar as season, round_number, meeting_name, position
from f1.results
where driver_id = '${params.driver}' and session_name = 'Race' and position is not null
order by year, round_number

queries.compiledQueryString:
with mine as (
    select session_key, year, team_name, position
    from f1.results
    where driver_id = '${params.driver}' and session_name = 'Qualifying' and position is not null
),
mate as (
    select r.session_key, r.driver_name as teammate, r.position
    from f1.results r
    join mine m on m.session_key = r.session_key and m.team_name = r.team_name
    where r.driver_id <> '${params.driver}' and r.session_name = 'Qualifying' and r.position is not null
)
select
    m.year,
    t.teammate,
    count(*) filter (m.position < t.position) as ahead,
    count(*) filter (m.position > t.position) as behind
from mine m join mate t using (session_key)
group by all
order by m.year desc, (ahead + behind) desc
